bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to veterans; appropriating money for a grant to Forgotten Heroes Ranges and Retreat.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; FORGOTTEN HEROES RANGES AND RETREAT.

$1,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of veterans affairs for a grant to Forgotten Heroes Ranges and Retreat, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, to predesign, design, construct, furnish, and equip a new shooting range and retreat to accommodate handicapped individuals and disabled veterans. This appropriation is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642. This is a onetime appropriation.
